segments.ja108:1.1: Sikkheyya sikkhitabbāni, santi tacchandino [sacchandino (sī. pī.)] janā;
segments.ja108:1.3: Bāhiyā hi [pi (sī. syā. pī.)] suhannena, rājānamabhirādhayīti.

lines: Tattha santi sacchandino janāti tesu tesu sippesu sacchandā janā atthiyeva.
Suhannenāti hirottappaṃ appahāya paṭicchannenākārena hannaṃ suhannaṃ nāma, tena suhannena.
Evaṃ mahāsatto sikkhitabbayuttakānaṃ sippānaṃ guṇaṃ kathesi.
